title: Apple WWDC 2022: M2 chip summary slide
lede: A specification slide in which every tile holds one large number in gradient type around a central image of the chip.
summary: Pale grey rounded tiles with very large orange-to-violet numbers around a dark M2 chip. WWDC 2022.

source.label: Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple WWDC 2022

evidence.note: Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP `[WWDC 2022]-[Mac]-[Apple M2 Chip].webp` from the fan archive [Apple Summary Slides](https://apple-summary-slides.vercel.app/events/wwdc-2022) (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: the number-per-tile form of the core look, with very large figures and short labels in tiles of mixed sizes.

context: Apple announced the M2 chip in the WWDC 2022 keynote on 6 June 2022. Deck.gallery describes the smallest tiles of these decks as holding specs such as “chip names, screen sizes, battery hours” ([Deck.gallery](https://www.deck.gallery/blog/apple-bento-grid-decks-roundup/)).
observed: Pale grey rounded tiles on an off-white ground, with narrow even gutters. The tiles form a symmetrical grid: a large central square, wide tiles at the outer edges, and small squares in pairs.
The central tile shows a black square chip with the Apple logo and “M2” in silver, with an orange, pink, and violet glow around it.
Almost every other tile holds one figure set very large in a bold sans-serif: “24GB”, “40%”, “15.8 trillion”, “18%”, “35%”, “20 billion”, “100GB/s”.

The figures and some headings are filled with a gradient that runs from orange at the left of the slide to pink and violet at the right. The small labels under them are dark grey or black and much smaller.
Two tiles show simple line drawings of CPU and GPU cores in the same gradient colors.
interpretation: This is the slide that the type marker of the record describes: the figure is the content, and its size states its importance. The gradient type is the only ornament.
borrow: Set one figure per tile at five to ten times the label size, with the unit attached (GB, %, GB/s).
Run one gradient across all figures on the slide, so that the color moves with position, not with the tile.

rights.statement: Frame of an Apple event video; copyrighted by Apple Inc. The fan archive states “All rights reserved by Apple Inc.” No image is stored here.
